children: An account linked to the GOLD project, realtrumpcoins, claimed it has made more than $8.2 million today from what it described as “low-IQ Trump supporters” and plans to add the proceeds to a $10 million bounty targeting Barron Trump. According to ChainCatcher, the account also claimed Barron Trump is currently worth $18.2 million and referred to $165 million in Solana allegedly stolen from his phone. The statements were made solely by the account and have not been independently verified.

title: GOLD Project Account Claims Over $8.2 Million Profit and $10 Million Barron Trump Bounty
